title: Tomcat releases security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-291.030620: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY- TOMCAT RELEASES SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: Tomcat has released security updates to address vulnerabilities affecting multiple products. This update for tomcat to version 9.0.31 fixes the following three (3) issues: CVE-2019-17569 , CVE-2020-1935 and CVE-2020-1938.
contentHtml:
Tomcat has released security updates to address vulnerabilities affecting multiple products. This update for tomcat to version 9.0.31 fixes the following three (3) issues: CVE-2019-17569, CVE-2020-1935 and CVE-2020-1938.

TT-CSIRT encourages users and administrators to review and apply the necessary updates:

https://www.suse.com/support/update/announcement/2020/suse-su-20200598-1
